title: Parkio Daily for Friday, November 27, 2026
teaser: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova debut at Avengers Campus this week ahead of Doomsday's December 18 release, while Magic Kingdom's Fab 50 statues start coming down.

bignews.title: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova debut at Avengers Campus
bignews.body: Winter Soldier and the assassin from Black Widow are now meeting guests at Avengers Campus ahead of Avengers: Doomsday hitting theaters December 18. The character rollout is part of a larger Doomsday celebration at Disneyland Resort running through the film's launch window.

parkioInsight.text: Character meet queues for new arrivals tend to spike in the first week. Visiting Avengers Campus within the first hour after park opening usually yields shorter waits for both Bucky and Yelena.

bignews.title: Magic Kingdom removes Fab 50 character statues
bignews.body: Disney World has started pulling down the golden character statues installed for the 50th anniversary, which were key interactive touchpoints for MagicBand+. The removal signals a phaseout of one of the band's marquee features across the resort.

parkioInsight.text: If your MagicBand+ experience relied on statue interactions, those features are likely gone or going. Switching focus to in-attraction lighting effects tends to offer more consistent value from the bands now.

bignews.title: Extended Evening Hours shifts away from Magic Kingdom in winter
bignews.body: The deluxe-resort perk is moving out of Magic Kingdom for winter 2027, with Animal Kingdom unexpectedly added to the February schedule. The park rotation continues to change without advance notice.

parkioInsight.text: If you're booking a deluxe stay for February, Animal Kingdom's Extended Hours typically deliver lower waits on Flight of Passage and Everest than Magic Kingdom's comparable windows. Check the calendar before locking park days.

topstories.title: Hexed merchandise and experiences now live at both resorts
topstories.body: Disney's newest animated film, which opened Wednesday, is supported by themed apparel, beauty products, and in-park activations at Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World. The film launched with cautious opening-day box office numbers lower than Wish.

parkioInsight.text: Film-tied merchandise tends to sell fastest in the first two weeks at flagship stores like World of Disney. Stopping by early morning or late evening usually avoids peak shopping crowds.

topstories.title: Avengers: Doomsday food and drink hits parks globally
topstories.body: Disneyland Resort, Hong Kong Disneyland, Tokyo Disney Resort, and Disneyland Paris have rolled out themed menu items tied to the December 18 Marvel film. The offerings span hero and villain motifs across multiple resort dining locations.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-time food typically draws lines at quick-service spots during lunch and dinner peaks. Ordering mobile or visiting between traditional meal windows often cuts wait by 10–15 minutes.

topstories.title: Disney and Formula 1 partnership returns for 2026 season
topstories.body: Mickey and Friends are back trackside as Disney and F1 continue their multi-year collaboration following last year's Las Vegas Grand Prix debut. The Fuel the Magic campaign will run through the 2026 race calendar.

parkioInsight.text: F1-Disney crossover merchandise tends to appear in limited drops at Disneyland and World of Disney locations. Checking inventory early in race weekends usually increases odds of finding co-branded items before sellouts.

topstories.title: Pirates of the Caribbean changes confirmed for 2027
topstories.body: Disney announced major updates coming to the classic attraction next year, marking the biggest planned shift revealed in November. Details on scope and timeline remain thin.

parkioInsight.text: If you want to experience the current version before changes begin, booking a trip in the first half of 2027 likely beats waiting. Major refurbs often close rides for 6–12 months once work starts.

topstories.title: Spaceship Earth refurbishment timing still unconfirmed
topstories.body: EPCOT's icon attraction is slated for its first major update in nearly 20 years, but Disney has not announced a closure date. The reimagining will require a lengthy ride shutdown once it begins.

parkioInsight.text: If Spaceship Earth is a must-do on your list, riding it sooner rather than later reduces the chance you'll arrive mid-refurb. Major icon attractions typically close with only 60–90 days notice.

topstories.title: Hallmark's Disney World holiday movie premieres this season
topstories.body: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True is the channel's first film set entirely at Walt Disney World. The production wrapped earlier this year with scenes shot across the resort during the holiday season.

parkioInsight.text: Holiday TV specials filmed at the parks often drive mid-December visitation spikes as viewers seek to recreate scenes. Expect heavier Christmas week crowds this year, especially at Magic Kingdom's tree and castle.

icymi.title: Disney gift card deals return for Black Friday weekend
icymi.body: Sam's Club, Target, Best Buy, and other major retailers are offering 10 percent cash-back promotions on Disney gift cards through the long weekend. The cards can be applied to park tickets, dining, and resort stays.

icymi.title: Disney Cruise Line debuts new gingerbread towers fleetwide
icymi.body: More than 700 pounds of powdered sugar and 1,300 pounds of gingerbread mix went into handcrafted holiday towers now on display across Disney's cruise ships. Eighty crew members worked on the seasonal installations.

icymi.title: Teacup Confessions celebrity interview series launches
icymi.body: Disney Parks Blog rolled out a new video format that pairs celebrity guests with spins on the Mad Tea Party. The interview series covers upcoming projects and Disney memories while the teacups whirl.

icymi.title: More than 6,000 Thanksgiving flights delayed nationwide
icymi.body: A Miami International Airport incident contributed to widespread travel disruptions, with nearly 150 cancellations on top of the delays. Disney World guests traveling over the holiday weekend faced longer-than-usual airport wait times.

spotlight.title: Disney home decor and holiday ornament gift guide
spotlight.body: The official Parks Blog released its 2026 holiday shopping guide covering Disney-themed kitchen supplies, ornaments, and home decor. The guide highlights items available online and at select retail locations.

parkioInsight.text: Popular ornament designs tend to sell out by mid-December at ShopDisney and in-park locations. Ordering early or checking World of Disney at Disney Springs before December 10 usually secures first-pick inventory.
